title: Native Higher-Call Prime-Power Divisibility Hierarchy Audit: p-Adic Subgroup Pinching Filtration, Telescoping Valuation Shells, and Zero-Sum Shell Increments

theorems.name: Exact Level-j p-Adic Subgroup Pinching Identity
theorems.statement: For q = p^r (p >= 3, r >= 2), averaging the k-call Born probability P_(epsilon, sigma)(x | s) over s uniform on the subgroup H_j = p^(r-j) Z_(p^r)^n pinches the double trajectory sum onto the congruence collision variety V_epsilon^(j)(f) = {(w, w') : tau_epsilon(w) == tau_epsilon(w') mod p^j}.

theorems.name: Monotone p-Adic Collision Filtration and Telescoping Valuation Shells
theorems.statement: The varieties V_epsilon^(0)(f) supseteq V_epsilon^(1)(f) supseteq ... supseteq V_epsilon^(r)(f) supseteq Delta_k form a monotone decreasing filtration whose valuation difference shells D_epsilon^(j)(f) = V_epsilon^(j)(f) \ V_epsilon^(j+1)(f) satisfy D^(2k) = |V_epsilon^(r)(f)| + sum_{j=0}^{r-1} |D_epsilon^(j)(f)|.

theorems.name: Diagonal Cancelation and Zero-Sum Conservation of p-Adic Shell Increments
theorems.statement: Every level-j probability shell increment Delta P_bar_(epsilon, sigma)^(j -> j+1)(x) = P_bar_(epsilon, sigma)^(j)(x) - P_bar_(epsilon, sigma)^(j+1)(x) is supported purely on the off-diagonal valuation shell D_epsilon^(j)(f), satisfies sum_{x=0}^{D-1} Delta P_bar_(epsilon, sigma)^(j -> j+1)(x) = 0, and telescopes to P_bar^(0)(x) - P_bar^(r)(x).
